videos.title: How Mozilla strengthens Firefox security with GPT-6 Cyber
videos.description:
Mozilla used GPT-6 Cyber to uncover previously unknown high-severity vulnerabilities in Firefox and identify architectural improvements. Its team shipped fixes to millions of users, turning findings into protections for the people who depend on the software.

Hear Brian Grinstead, Distinguished Engineer for Firefox, share Mozilla’s experience and what stronger AI can mean for software defense.

https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-6-cyber/

videos.title: Made to Make: The Cat in the Hat | Extended Cut
videos.description:
The Cat’s out of the bag, and the bag is full of filmmaking secrets.  

In this extended cut of Autodesk’s series "Made to Make", go behind the scenes at Warner Bros. Pictures Animation to meet the artists and filmmakers with a gift for the wonderfully absurd. They tell us:

How do you turn a short book into a feature film?
How do you create a look that’s new but still Dr. Seuss?
What tools are shaping a new era of animation at the studio? 

See #TheCatintheHat only in theaters November 6.

videos.title: Heavy Attack Dragonknight Solo Build | ESO Update 51
videos.description:
Pure Class Heavy Attack Dragonknight Solo Build for ESO Update 51. Molten Armaments gives you Empower for 30 seconds, so you don't have to recast a Mages Guild ability every 10 seconds to keep it up like other Heavy Attack builds do. That leaves room to keep up more abilities. It's very easy to play, but damage is only a bit higher than Heavy Attack Sorcerer and a lot lower than Heavy Attack Nightblade.

This setup cleared Solo Moon Hunter Keep and Solo March of Sacrifices with 3 Misfortunes, and parses 59.4k DPS on the 6 million dummy.

Works for all kinds of solo content - overland at any Challenge Difficulty up to Vestige, World Bosses, Maelstrom Arena, Vateshran Hollows, early arcs in Infinite Archive, and Veteran Dungeon soloing.
